name: structural-scanner-anchor-relocation
body: Reconciliation of the structural-scanner `implemented-by` anchors (coordinator correction B) [with coordinator]. Source statement: `solution.container.structural-scanner` was `implemented-by` `rust.mdfrontend`; `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` was `implemented-by` `rust.mdfrontend` / `rust.mdfrontend.main` / `rust.mdfrontend.run`; and `solution.component.structural-format-emitters` was `implemented-by` `rust.mdfrontend.walk` / `.parse_headings` / `.line_count` / `.build_doc`. Inconsistency: those FQNs were the inbound `src/mdlib` Markdown frontend the change-set absorbs into `src/structlib` (binary `structfrontend`); once `src/mdlib` is gone the verify gate would have seen the eight drifted edges as drift. Resolution LANDED (task `apg-0.17.0/plan.phase-01.task-14`): after the branch re-scan made the `rust.structfrontend.*` units resolve, the spec-writer under coordinator routing ran the durable `apg edge` rm/add re-point of all eight drifted `implemented-by` edge pairs over seven distinct FQNs to their `rust.structfrontend.*` successors — `rust.mdfrontend` (on BOTH `solution.container.structural-scanner` and `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate`, 2 edges), `rust.mdfrontend.main` and `rust.mdfrontend.run` (`solution.component.structural-scanner-crate`), and `rust.mdfrontend.walk`/`.parse_headings`/`.line_count`/`.build_doc` (`solution.component.structural-format-emitters`). All eight anchors now resolve to `rust.structfrontend` / `.main` / `.run` / `.walk` / `.parse_headings` / `.line_count` / `.build_doc`, and zero `rust.mdfrontend.*` `implemented-by` edges remain. No edge was ever authored to a non-existent FQN, per the parent-cannot-depend-on-the-child rule. See `solution.note.structural-scanner-oroboros` for the companion rule that no next-binary File surface is targeted. [with coordinator]
